question: Can an App enable auto-merge and enter the merge queue, and take a pull request out of it before the queue merges it? And does the poller read a change before the queue merges it? Does a push take a queued pull request out, can the queue eject one without merging it, its approval staying, is a draft ever merged by a person or the queue, and does the queue run the required checks on the merge group? Is each enqueue and dequeue on the pull request's timeline, naming its actor?
pass: Written 2026-10-29, before window 3 ran (runbook-window-3, issues 381 and 389): the queue App, its permissions narrowed to contents: write and metadata: read alone, enqueues an approved pull request, dequeues it, and resolves another's thread, each answered with no error; under the canary ruleset's required_review_thread_resolution, (i) an enqueue with a thread open is refused, and (ii) a thread opened while it waits ejects it or does not, recorded either way; fail only if (i) enqueues and (ii) merges. factory-queue deploys from main alone, admins cannot bypass it, and it holds one secret, the queue App's key. The ruleset's requirement was set true for the window and back to false after, each read before and after, the rest of the ruleset unchanged. Passed. Every mint granted contents: write and metadata: read alone. (i) The queue App's enqueue of canary pull request 70, approved with three threads open, was refused: a conversation must be resolved; an earlier try, before the approval, was refused for the code owner's review. Its resolve is P-5.queue.json. (ii) With every thread resolved, it enqueued 70; a person's thread opened 8 seconds later left 70 in the queue, BLOCKED, and the queue merged it when its merge group's check passed, the thread still open: the requirement is checked at the enqueue, not while a pull request waits. The merge names the queue App. Canary pull request 71 was approved and queued in the browser by the machine user, unplanned, and merged, naming the machine user. On canary pull request 72 the queue App enqueued and dequeued, reason manual, unmerged; tried before the approval, both were refused for the pull request's state, never for permission. Canary pull request 70 was opened by the Maintainer through the contents API, and its rate-limited CodeRabbit asked once, writes not recorded here.
